# refuted (□¬, false)

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:refuted`](gmeow-refuted.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/refuted>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/standpoint`](../../slices/standpoint.md)

□¬_S — settled false according to the standpoint: the standpoint DENIES the proposition ([CRMinf](../../external/ontologies.md#target-crminf) belief value 'false'). Distinct from silence (no claim) and from low [`gmeow:confidence`](../properties/gmeow-confidence.md) — an explicit, recorded denial. The proposition is carried as the subject of the denial, never asserted as a fact of the universal standpoint.
